metadata.description: Deterministic ADB debloating and telemetry registry for Xiaomi HyperOS, MIUI, Samsung One UI, and standard Android core systems (Non-Root).

packages.name: MIUI Analytics Daemon
packages.impact_summary: Stops continuous background telemetry and user tracking. Note: Framework automatically purges hidden /data/app updates first to prevent the known 500mA system_server/WebView CPU spin loop.

packages.name: MIUI System Ads (MSA Global)
packages.impact_summary: Disables central push advertising engine in HyperOS. Note: Framework automatically purges hidden /data/app updates first to prevent the known 500mA system_server/WebView CPU spin loop.

packages.name: Xiaomi Joyose Game / Telemetry Daemon
packages.impact_summary: DO NOT TOUCH. Empirically validated on HyperOS: controls dynamic CPU thermal regulation safety limits AND provides the system bridge for SMS OTP auto-parsing in Banking and FinTech apps. Removal risks thermal runaway and breaks banking SMS verification.

packages.name: MIUI Quick Apps / Hybrid App Runtime
packages.impact_summary: Prevents unauthorized background execution of mini-apps, promotional web wrappers, and tracking notifications.

packages.name: MIUI Quick Apps Accessory Engine
packages.impact_summary: Stops secondary background polling and support libraries for Quick Apps runtime.

packages.name: MIUI Bug Report & Log Uploader
packages.impact_summary: Halts silent dump collections, log compression, and crash transmission to remote diagnostic endpoints.

packages.name: Mi Services & User Feedback
packages.impact_summary: Disables diagnostic survey prompts and background feedback transmission.

packages.name: Google Play Feedback Reporter
packages.impact_summary: Prevents automated transmission of crash logs and device metrics to Google servers.

packages.name: MIUI Yellow Page & Caller ID Engine
packages.impact_summary: Eliminates commercial directory lookups, caller identification telemetry, and targeted marketing banners in dialer.

packages.name: GetApps (Xiaomi App Store)
packages.impact_summary: Removes duplicate proprietary app store, non-stop update nag notifications, and promotional app pushes.

packages.name: Xiaomi Game Center
packages.impact_summary: Eliminates game promotion hub, lockscreen game banners, and in-game ad overlays.

packages.name: Mi Video Player
packages.impact_summary: Replaces adware-ridden media player with clean open-source alternatives like VLC or Just Video Player.

packages.name: Mi Music Player
packages.impact_summary: Removes integrated music streaming service with persistent promotional pushes and audio ad injections.

packages.name: ShareMe (Mi Drop)
packages.impact_summary: Disables proprietary P2P file transfer tool known for sending push promotions; standard Quick Share / Nearby Share remains active.

packages.name: Kingsoft Translation Provider
packages.impact_summary: Stops background tracking and queries routed through external third-party Kingsoft translation APIs.

packages.name: Xiaomi Translator Service
packages.impact_summary: Terminates unnecessary translation background daemon.

packages.name: MIUI Compass
packages.impact_summary: Removes stock compass app bundled with analytics and location-sharing probes.

packages.name: MIUI Calculator
packages.impact_summary: Replaces telemetry-equipped calculator with AOSP or Fossify Calculator.

packages.name: MIUI Weather
packages.impact_summary: Removes stock weather app notorious for feed ads and third-party data broker geolocation pings.

packages.name: Xiaomi Mi Pay Framework
packages.impact_summary: Disables unneeded proprietary Xiaomi payment daemon (Google Pay / Google Wallet operates independently and remains 100% functional).

packages.name: Facebook Client (Pre-installed)
packages.impact_summary: Removes OEM factory-installed Facebook stub app.

packages.name: Facebook System Service
packages.impact_summary: Terminates privileged background service tracking device installation events for Meta advertising graph.

packages.name: Facebook App Manager
packages.impact_summary: Prevents silent sideloading and background updating of Meta components outside Google Play.

packages.name: Facebook Core Services
packages.impact_summary: Eliminates continuous Facebook analytics beacons embedded at the system partition level.

packages.name: Tencent Soter Biometric Daemon
packages.impact_summary: Removes biometric payment connector used exclusively for Chinese WeChat payment verification.

packages.name: Qualcomm BSP CatchLog Collector
packages.impact_summary: Disables chip-level modem and chipset event logging service, saving storage writes and CPU cycles.

packages.name: MIUI System Daemon
packages.impact_summary: Halts persistent background service responsible for device telemetry aggregation.

packages.name: Mi Cloud Sync Push Provider
packages.impact_summary: Stops background synchronization push requests to Xiaomi cloud servers.

packages.name: Frequent Phrases Telemetry
packages.impact_summary: Removes stock clipboard snippet aggregator.

packages.name: Xiaomi Cloud Core Framework
packages.impact_summary: Disables all Xiaomi Cloud synchronization (Contacts, Notes, Find Device, SMS). Only remove if you do NOT rely on Xiaomi Cloud.

packages.name: Xiaomi Cloud System Base
packages.impact_summary: Low-level system integration provider for Xiaomi account sync.

packages.name: Xiaomi Cloud Backup Client
packages.impact_summary: Stops automatic nightly cloud backups of app data and layout to Xiaomi servers.

packages.name: MIUI / HyperOS Stock Gallery
packages.impact_summary: Stock gallery application with integrated cloud backup and face recognition. Removing requires a 3rd party gallery (e.g. Google Photos or Fossify Gallery) installed first.

packages.name: Tencent CleanMaster Security Module
packages.impact_summary: Deactivates third-party Tencent CleanMaster definitions inside Security app. Note: Some HyperOS versions show a benign toast if deep cleaner is manually tapped.

packages.name: Mi Browser / Mint Browser
packages.impact_summary: Removes heavy proprietary browser known for tracking queries and sending URLs to remote proxies. Ensure alternative browser (Firefox/Chrome/Brave) is installed first.

packages.name: MIUI Screen Recorder
packages.impact_summary: System screen recording tool. Remove only if screen recording is not required or an alternative is preferred.

packages.name: MIUI Notes
packages.impact_summary: Stock notes application. Caution: Any notes not backed up or synced will be inaccessible until restored.

packages.name: Google Meet
packages.impact_summary: Google video calling client. Safe to remove if not actively used.

packages.name: Google TV
packages.impact_summary: Google media store and video library client.

packages.name: YouTube Music
packages.impact_summary: Preloaded YouTube Music client. Safe to remove if another music app or Spotify is preferred.

packages.name: Google Chrome
packages.impact_summary: Google Chrome browser. Ensure another web browser (e.g. Firefox, Brave) is installed before uninstalling.

packages.name: Xiao AI / Mi AI Voice Assistant
packages.impact_summary: Proprietary Xiaomi assistant. Remove if Google Assistant or no assistant is preferred.

packages.name: MIUI / HyperOS Security Center
packages.impact_summary: DO NOT TOUCH. Core HyperOS framework holding permission management, battery settings, network firewall, and thermal dispatchers. Removal causes fatal bootloop or system settings crashes.

packages.name: Android In-Call UI Framework
packages.impact_summary: DO NOT TOUCH. The active telephony display screen interface. Removal completely breaks incoming and outgoing voice calls.

packages.name: Android System UI
packages.impact_summary: DO NOT TOUCH. Manages status bar, navigation bar, quick settings panel, notification shade, and lockscreen. Removal causes immediate crash loops.

packages.name: MIUI / HyperOS System Launcher
packages.impact_summary: DO NOT TOUCH. Default home screen and recent apps overview provider. Removal without an active alternative default launcher renders the device completely inaccessible.

packages.name: Phone Services & Telephony Base
packages.impact_summary: DO NOT TOUCH. Cellular radio modem integration, SIM card registration, and emergency calling. Removal breaks all cellular functionality.

packages.name: Google Play Services
packages.impact_summary: DO NOT TOUCH. Core Google platform runtime, Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM push notifications), location APIs, and Play Integrity checks. Removal breaks almost all third-party banking, messaging, and Google apps.

packages.name: Android System Settings Provider
packages.impact_summary: DO NOT TOUCH. The core device settings application and preferences database. Removal leaves the device unconfigurable.

packages.name: Android Package Installer
packages.impact_summary: DO NOT TOUCH. Core OS package installer and permission granting interface. Removal prevents installing or updating applications.

packages.name: Telephony and SMS Provider
packages.impact_summary: DO NOT TOUCH. SMS/MMS message database and carrier APN settings provider. Removal breaks messaging and mobile data configurations.

packages.name: MIUI / HyperOS Theme & Lockscreen Engine
packages.impact_summary: DO NOT TOUCH. Core framework powering lockscreen rendering, Always-On-Display (AOD) assets, and system wallpapers. Removal or corruption breaks device lockscreen unlocking.

packages.name: Xiaomi SIM Activation Service
packages.impact_summary: DO NOT TOUCH. Essential for cellular carrier registration, network provisioning, and SIM security handshakes in multi-SIM / eSIM environments.

packages.name: Gallery Photo & Video Editor Suite
packages.impact_summary: Removes integrated gallery video and photo editing plugins. Base gallery viewing remains operational.

packages.name: Mi Scanner & Camera QR Utility
packages.impact_summary: Document scanning and QR reading subsystem integrated into camera. Removal disables QR scanning inside native camera app.

packages.name: Mi Remote (IR Controller)
packages.impact_summary: Infrared blaster remote controller app. Can be removed if the physical IR transmitter is not used.

packages.name: Bixby Vision
packages.impact_summary: Removes Bixby Vision image-recognition feature. No impact on core OS functionality. Camera app loses the Bixby lens shortcut but continues to work normally.

packages.name: Bixby Voice
packages.impact_summary: Disables Bixby voice assistant entirely. Side button can be remapped. No system instability. Some Bixby Routines voice triggers will stop working.

packages.name: Bixby Dictation
packages.impact_summary: Removes Bixby dictation/speech-to-text backend. Samsung Keyboard voice input falls back to Google speech services. No system impact.

packages.name: Bixby Routines
packages.impact_summary: Removes Bixby Routines automation engine. All user-configured routines (e.g., auto-Wi-Fi, bedtime mode triggers) will stop running. Tasker or MacroDroid can replace this. Modes and Routines settings panel will be empty.

packages.name: Samsung Free (Bixby Home)
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Free news/entertainment feed from the leftmost home screen panel. Eliminates ads and background data usage. No system impact whatsoever.

packages.name: Game Launcher
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Game Launcher hub. Games still launch normally from app drawer. Game-specific performance profiles via Game Booster may become unavailable.

packages.name: Game Booster / Game Tools
packages.impact_summary: Removes in-game overlay (screenshot, recording, do-not-disturb, performance monitor). Games continue to run without issue. No system impact.

packages.name: AR Zone
packages.impact_summary: Removes AR Zone hub including AR Doodle and AR effects. Camera app loses AR mode shortcuts but all other camera functions remain intact.

packages.name: AR Emoji
packages.impact_summary: Removes AR Emoji avatar creation and sticker generation. Samsung Keyboard loses AR Emoji sticker tab. No impact on camera or messaging.

packages.name: Samsung Tips
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Tips app that shows promotional content and device tutorials. Eliminates tip notifications. Zero system impact.

packages.name: Samsung Experience Service
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Experience Service telemetry framework. Stops Samsung from collecting usage analytics. Samsung Account sign-in may show occasional errors but remains functional.

packages.name: Samsung Analytics (Dual DA Agent)
packages.impact_summary: Disables Samsung diagnostic analytics data collection agent. Stops background telemetry uploads. No user-facing features are affected.

packages.name: Samsung Push Service
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung's proprietary push notification service. Samsung apps (Galaxy Store, Samsung Pay, Samsung Members) will no longer receive push notifications. Does not affect Google FCM-based notifications from third-party apps.

packages.name: Samsung Cloud
packages.impact_summary: Disables Samsung Cloud backup and sync. Gallery cloud sync, Samsung Notes sync, and Settings backup to Samsung Cloud will stop. Existing cloud data is not deleted. Google Drive backup remains unaffected.

packages.name: Samsung Pass (Auth Framework)
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Pass biometric autofill and password manager. Saved passwords in Samsung Pass become inaccessible. Samsung Internet browser autofill via Samsung Pass will stop. Biometric unlock for the device itself is NOT affected.

packages.name: Samsung Pass
packages.impact_summary: Removes the Samsung Pass UI and credential management. Web autofill via Samsung Pass is lost. Users relying on Samsung Pass for password storage should migrate to an alternative manager first.

packages.name: Samsung Internet Browser
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Internet browser. Default browser intent falls back to Chrome or another installed browser. Bookmarks and saved data in Samsung Internet are lost from the device. Some Samsung deep links may fail to open until another default browser is set.

packages.name: Samsung Email
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Email client. Users must use Gmail or another email app. Configured email accounts in Samsung Email will need to be re-added elsewhere.

packages.name: Samsung Calendar
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Calendar app. Google Calendar or another calendar app should be installed as replacement. Calendar data synced via Google Account remains safe. Samsung-specific calendar widgets will disappear.

packages.name: Samsung Finder
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Finder universal search from home screen. Swipe-down search on the home screen will stop working. App drawer search is a separate function and remains available.

packages.name: Galaxy Wearable (Stub)
packages.impact_summary: Removes the Galaxy Wearable stub installer. This only prompts users to download the full Galaxy Wearable app. If you own a Galaxy Watch, install the full app from the Play Store instead. No system impact.

packages.name: Galaxy Themes
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Galaxy Themes store. Wallpaper and theme downloads via Samsung are disabled. Currently applied theme remains intact. Third-party launchers and wallpaper apps are unaffected.

packages.name: Samsung Wallpaper Services
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung's Wallpaper services including dynamic/video wallpapers from Samsung. Static wallpapers and Google wallpaper picker remain functional.

packages.name: Samsung Customization Service
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung's personalization and content recommendation engine. Stops collection of usage patterns for ad targeting and content suggestions in Samsung apps. No system impact.

packages.name: AR Emoji Stickers (Preload)
packages.impact_summary: Removes preloaded AR Emoji sticker assets. Frees storage space. No impact on camera or messaging functionality.

packages.name: AR Doodle
packages.impact_summary: Removes AR Doodle augmented reality drawing feature from the camera. Camera app continues to function normally in all other modes.

packages.name: Samsung Contacts
packages.impact_summary: Core contacts provider deeply integrated with Samsung Dialer and Messages. Removal breaks call log display, contact lookup, and can cause SystemUI crashes. Essential for telephony stack.

packages.name: Samsung In-Call UI
packages.impact_summary: Provides the in-call screen (answer, reject, hold, merge). Removal makes it impossible to interact with active phone calls and can cause telephony service crashes.

packages.name: Samsung Phone / Dialer
packages.impact_summary: Core phone dialer application. Removal completely disables the ability to make or receive phone calls and breaks emergency dialing. Causes telephony framework errors.

packages.name: Samsung Messages
packages.impact_summary: Default SMS/MMS/RCS handler. Removal breaks SMS delivery on devices without Google Messages pre-installed. May cause MMS APN configuration loss and notification framework errors.

packages.name: One UI Home (Launcher)
packages.impact_summary: Default Samsung home screen launcher. Removal without an alternative launcher pre-configured causes a bootloop to the home screen selection prompt or a soft-brick state. Essential for device usability.

packages.name: Samsung SystemUI
packages.impact_summary: Core system UI framework providing status bar, notification shade, quick settings, lock screen, and navigation bar. Removal causes immediate and continuous system crashes rendering the device unusable.

packages.name: Samsung Digital Wellbeing
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung's Digital Wellbeing integration layer. Screen time tracking, app timers, and Focus Mode may stop working. Google's Digital Wellbeing (if present) can serve as replacement.

packages.name: Samsung Quick Share / Live Sharing
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung's live screen sharing feature used during calls. Quick Share file transfer is a separate package and remains functional. No system impact.

packages.name: Samsung Pay
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Pay mobile payment platform. MST and NFC payments via Samsung Pay will stop. Google Pay/Wallet remains fully functional as alternative. Swipe-up gesture from home screen is freed.

packages.name: Samsung Pay Framework
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Pay backend framework. Required by Samsung Pay — removing this without removing Samsung Pay first may cause crashes. NFC hardware itself remains functional for Google Pay.

packages.name: Samsung DeX System
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung DeX desktop experience. USB-C/wireless display output for desktop mode will no longer function. Standard screen mirroring via Smart View remains available.

packages.name: Samsung Voice Input
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung's proprietary voice input engine. Google Voice Typing remains available as the keyboard voice input method. No system impact.

packages.name: Samsung SmartThings (Stub)
packages.impact_summary: Removes SmartThings preloaded stub/framework. If you use SmartThings IoT devices, reinstall from Play Store. Device-to-device features (Smart View casting) have separate packages and are unaffected.

packages.name: Samsung Members
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Members community and support app. Diagnostic reports, community forums, and Samsung support chat become inaccessible. No system impact. Can be reinstalled from Galaxy Store.

packages.name: Samsung Weather
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Weather app and its home screen / lock screen widgets. Always-On Display weather info may disappear. Clock app weather integration may break. Install a third-party weather app as replacement.

packages.name: Samsung Screen Capture / Smart Capture
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung's enhanced screenshot toolbar (scroll capture, crop, draw, share). Basic screenshot via button combo still works but the post-capture editing toolbar is lost.

packages.name: Samsung Kids Installer
packages.impact_summary: Removes Samsung Kids stub installer from Quick Settings panel. This only downloads the full Samsung Kids app when tapped. No impact on parental controls provided by Google Family Link.

packages.name: Samsung Device Care Well-being
packages.impact_summary: Removes the well-being component from Samsung Device Care. Screen time features and wind-down mode are disabled. Battery and storage optimization in Device Care remain functional.

packages.name: Samsung Story Service
packages.impact_summary: Removes background service that auto-generates highlight reels and stories in Samsung Gallery. Gallery app continues to function normally for viewing and editing photos.

packages.name: Pixel Tips
packages.impact_summary: Removes the Pixel Tips setup tips app. No system impact; the app only shows feature highlights and promotional device tutorials after setup.

packages.name: Google Setup Wizard
packages.impact_summary: Removing this breaks the factory reset flow — the device will boot into a broken setup state after a factory reset. Only remove if you are absolutely certain you will never factory reset the device.

packages.name: Google Digital Wellbeing
packages.impact_summary: Generates hundreds of daily URGENT_ALARM wakeups to monitor app usage in the background. Removing stops all background usage tracking and reduces wakelock events, but the Digital Wellbeing entry disappears from Settings.

packages.name: Google Play Books
packages.impact_summary: Unused e-reader app preloaded on most Android devices. Safe to remove; no system dependencies. Reinstall from Play Store if needed.

packages.name: Google Play Newsstand
packages.impact_summary: Google news aggregator rarely used by most users. Safe to remove with no system impact or dependency conflicts.

packages.name: Android Auto Stub
packages.impact_summary: Android Auto stub/framework. Safe to remove only if Android Auto is never used. Removing breaks wireless and wired Android Auto projection to car head units.

packages.name: Google Partner Setup
packages.impact_summary: OEM/carrier partner setup telemetry agent. Transmits device provisioning data to carrier and OEM partners during initial setup. No user-facing functionality; safe to remove post-setup.

packages.name: Google Files
packages.impact_summary: Duplicate file manager. Safe to remove only if another file manager is installed. Removing without an alternative leaves the device without a built-in file browser for local storage management.
